This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，the time noun is already sufficient; adding the extra time phrase is redundant.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看：看到，use the resultative form when the meaning is “see” rather than “look at.”
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 一天，神农：一天，他，after a character has just been introduced and no other character competes as the referent, use a pronoun for the close re-occurrence.
4. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 一看到很多人正在吃一些植物。：一看到很多人正在吃一些植物，就……，the pattern for an immediate sequence is “一…就…”, so the second event needs the connector.

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
The intended perception event requires 看到 rather than bare 看.
A close re-mention should use 他 under the teacher's reference rule, but the displayed correction is cut off before its predicate.
一…就… needs a completed following main clause, but the proposed correction leaves 就 dangling with an ellipsis.
